scope: Row-mapping calibration (isolated discriminating H) plus one small black picture on the unchanged 1148 family; research only

refined.grid: beta step 0.00002 in [-0.004,0], c step 0.0004 in [0,1); same 8-line training rule as row-family-v1

labelRule.sections: all 19 body x of each probe are mandatory; any missing/invalid -> INCOMPLETE before arithmetic
labelRule.accept: median(|g(top)-topPhase-j|)<=0.15 AND median(|g(bottom)-bottomPhase-(j+2)|)<=0.15 on every probe; otherwise the whole calibration is INCOMPLETE (no nearest label)
labelRule.filter: keep members with floor(scale*a/(1-a/poleY)+c)+offset==j, a=Y+beta*(Y-670), for EVERY probe; empty -> MODEL_CONTRADICTED for that family
labelRule.audit: derived members: Y 220..1100, unanimous index and min margin>=0.25, projected top/bottom edges inside [219.5,1100.5]; rows, longest, longest supported, first 40-row start

predictions.body: every planned run: every integer x of its path at its commandY is strong paint (gray drop>80) in the final picture frame vs the blank stage-before
predictions.dEvents: 0 D-events on every listed edge (adjacent |delta|>=0.3 px, contiguous same sign, accumulated |sum|>=1.2 px)
predictions.outside: no RGB>12 change outside the reservations (collector rejects per stroke; review re-checks final vs baseline)
predictions.descriptive: run extents/ends, edge offsets and width only described; asymmetric starts (~-5 px) NOT compensated

order: probes in listed order, then picture runs top-to-bottom, left-to-right
